assessments.name: Studio Engagement
assessments.description: Weekly in-class studio group activities support prototyping, iteration, and design development. Short reflective prompts are completed during tutorials.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Initial Group Project Pitch
assessments.description: Initial pitch of design idea for group project presented in week 4 tutorial. Slide decks are due on Friday week 3.

assessments.name: Draft Project Data Submission
assessments.description: Draft group lab report for design project (with draft design submissions)

assessments.name: Interactive oral 1
assessments.description: ‘Viva style’/interactive oral examination. Group based, marked individually

assessments.name: Group project presentation
assessments.description: Final proposal pitch for major group project presented to a panel of industry experts occurring in weeks 12 and 13 tutorials. Slide decks are due on Friday Week 11.

assessments.name: Reflection Journal
assessments.description: Students submit one consolidated, handwritten journal demonstrating learning progression, iteration, and reflective integration across the semester
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Reflection Portfolio
assessments.description:
Short structured reflections produced in-room or immediately after selected Live panel sessions. 
Reflections are submitted at four checkpoints across the semester and marked in clusters to manage workload while ensuring sustained engagement.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Live Questioning
assessments.description: Students demonstrate active listening and professional engagement by asking a minimum number of purposeful, live questions during panel sessions across the semester (e.g. at least one question in each half of semester).
